subject: FastBank - saturation at Dedicated pool causing increased latency and 5xxs
content:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@fastbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fastbank.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: sudden latency + 500s on dedicated pool (FastBank production)

Mina —

We're seeing a material increase in median latency for our critical inference route (embeddings/generate) starting ~14:45 PDT. A subset of requests are returning 500s and the queue depth is spiking. Our ops team tracked a drop in processed tokens per minute and attached a short CSV showing throughput. This is on the Dedicated pool you provisioned for us (deal FB-2026-09-RSV01).

We need visibility and an ETA for remediation; this is impacting checkout flows (customer-facing). Please escalate.

Thanks,
Alex
Principal Platform Engineer — FastBank

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@fastbank.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: sudden latency + 500s on dedicated pool (FastBank production)

Folks — looping in infra/ops and our priority CS lead. Alex sent throughput and 500 traces (attached). Initial triage:
- Preliminary signal: sustained queue depth on the FB dedicated pool; token throughput down ~35% vs baseline.
- Error pattern: 500s concentrated on requests that exceed 1024 context; we currently route to a quantized variant on this pool.

David / Olga — can you confirm current headroom % on the pool, recent kernel changes, and whether there was an autoscaler event in the last hour?

Marissa — please prepare a short note we can share with FastBank leadership; they requested an exec-level update if this cannot be resolved in 60–90 mins.

I will coordinate with Alex on a temporary fallback.

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: throughput_report_apr28.csv (CSV, 42KB), error_snapshot_500s.png (PNG, 1.8MB)

---

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: sudden latency + 500s on dedicated pool (FastBank production)

Quick update from infra: headroom on FB-dedicated-pool is at ~6% now (was ~28% an hour ago). We saw a burst of large-context requests from a single tenant namespace that increased KV cache pressure and prevented effective batching. No kernel patch or deployment in the last 6 hours.

Actions taken:
- Throttled non-critical tenant namespaces to free slots (temporary).
- Forced fallback routing for generation route to the compatible hosted-variant for FastBank (will reduce latency but increases cost and token doubling).
- Spun up 2 additional reserved workers in burst mode; they are coming online (ETA ~12 mins).

I'll monitor and post another update after the nodes join.

—David
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@fastbank.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: sudden latency + 500s on dedicated pool (FastBank production)

Alex / Lena —
Short note for your execs: we detected an unexpected surge of large-context traffic in the FastBank reserved pool that increased queue depth and caused transient 500s. Immediate mitigations: temporary throttles on noisy namespaces, fallback routing to hosted-variant for critical routes, and a burst of reserved workers to restore headroom. Expecting measurable improvement within ~15 mins of worker join.

We will follow up with a post-incident breakdown including token-level cost impact and a corrective action plan to avoid recurrence (KV cache protection, stricter per-namespace limits, and a long-term autoscaler tuning).

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

---

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@fastbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fastbank.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: sudden latency + 500s on dedicated pool (FastBank production)

Thanks — we see error rates dropping and median latency improving. Two quick asks from our side:
1) We need an interim mutual action plan (MAP) that lists who will do what and timelines; procurement/ops will ask for approvals for any burst charges.
2) Please confirm whether fallback to hosted increases our per-token billing (approx estimate) so we can route approvals.

We'll keep monitoring and will escalate to Lena if the window re-opens.

—Alex

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@fastbank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 18:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: sudden latency + 500s on dedicated pool (FastBank production) — MAP and next steps

Alex / Lena —

Summary and MAP (interim):
- What happened: spike of large-context requests (single tenant namespace) increased KV cache miss rate and queue depth, dropping throughput by ~35% and producing transient 500s on the dedicated pool.
- Immediate fixes completed (04/28): throttled noisy namespaces, routed critical paths to hosted fallback, spun up 2 burst workers; headroom restored to ~22% and error rate returned to baseline.

Interim MAP (owners + ETA):
- Redwood infra (David Kim) — confirm autoscaler tuning and add short-term per-namespace rate limit: ETA 6 hours.
- Redwood ops (Olga Petrov) — run a 24h traffic replay and surface any other noisy tenants: ETA 12 hours.
- Customer (Alex Gomez) — provide the list of FastBank routes that must never be throttled and approve hosted-fallback cost threshold: ETA 2 hours.
- Customer success (Marissa Cole) — prepare exec summary and cost / credit proposal if burst workers lead to overage: ETA 4 hours.

Cost note: fallback to hosted increases per-token unit cost by ~2.3x for generation-heavy routes; spinning burst workers will incur reserved-burst fees but keeps routing within FastBank's private pool. We'll include a conservative estimate in the cost note.

We've opened RES-4578 for the RCA and longer-term mitigation tracking. I will join a 1:1 with Lena and Marissa tomorrow morning if helpful.

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_draft.docx (DOCX, 28KB)
